notes: Multi-stage classifier pipeline that must be fully config-driven (data/outputs/knobs) and generalize to a fresh dataset mounted at verify time. It must fit a real scikit-learn linear model whose coefficient vector length equals the feature count and whose constrained feature is strictly negative (enforced deterministically by refit-on-flipped-column + coefficient remap, not just 'trust the data'), meet an accuracy floor on independent held-out rows for every hidden dataset, persist a plain row-wise numeric vector file loadable by numpy.loadtxt, emit config/metrics/progress under a config-specified experiment-data directory, and expose a Hydra debug override (debug.enabled=true) that shortens training to a single epoch + small batch while keeping all other defaults. hidden cases probe generalization to fresh datasets with different effect magnitudes/noise, plus a malformed dataset (missing the constrained column) that must trigger a clean non-zero exit without clobbering the good model. Hard: difficulty comes from the chained config->fit->sign-enforce->gate->persist stages, written ML correctness (sign/shape/accuracy/vector), hidden generalization, and the debug-override semantics. Note the nominal scenario target was 'medium' but the highest competency floor (C-2b609283, numeric vector file) is 'hard', so the bucket is hard to honor the >= max-floor rule.
